items.title: Let WorkClient.tree name the Media Discovery world
items.description: Our work backend now projects items from more than one world, but `WorkClient.tree` always returns the default projection. I need `tree` to accept an optional world name so I can ask for the Media Discovery projection. When the world is named, the request must carry it as a `world` query parameter on the tree path; when it is omitted, the request must stay exactly as it is today with no query string.
acceptance_criteria: tree() with no argument requests the tree path with no query string
tree({ world: "media-discovery" }) requests the tree path with the world query parameter
